name: @realitycollective/native-interactions
description: Native host adapter for the Reality Collective Interaction Extensions - reads the `input`, `interactions` and `physics` slices a native app (OpenXR, visionOS) installs on `globalThis.__rcHost`, or an injected fake, maps them into the engine-free @realitycollective/webxr-interactions core, hands the host the resolved pointer drawing, and ships the host conformance kit a native app runs on its device. No engine dependency: assets and rendering stay in the native app. Re-exports the core.
author: Reality Collective
